data.observed: Independent audit found one P1: explicit-defaults.yaml authored required=true on the global specimen_id Slot, changing its required=false Slot fact instead of merely exposing the identifier-induced effective SlotUse value. The repair removed that member and its test pop expectation, left effective SlotUse required=true implicit, and then passed all 4 focused tests plus Ruff. Exact inventory, strict JSON/YAML loading, confined paths, CC-018 references, bounded deltas, and absence of result fields remained enforced.

summary: Repair the audited global-Slot versus effective-SlotUse defect.
